name: Fizzle's Claw
summary: In Thunder Ridge, Fizzle Darkstorm’s claw is carried to Razor Hill as proof of his death. The goblin warlock threatened the orcish homeland under the Burning Blade’s banner.

sections.title: A Grim Trophy
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar sent forces to root out shadow cults threatening the orcish homeland. He named Fizzle Darkstorm as an instigator spreading corruption in Thunder Ridge. Fizzle served the Burning Blade as a warlock. His claw now proves to Horde commanders that he has been slain.

sections.title: The Threat in Thunder Ridge
sections.body: Thunder Ridge lies just northwest of Razor Hill, close enough to threaten the surrounding lands. Horde scouts carried Fizzle’s claw back to Razor Hill. It confirms that his rituals and attempt to establish a Burning Blade foothold have been stopped.

faq.q: Who does this claw belong to?
faq.answer: The claw belonged to Fizzle Darkstorm, a goblin warlock affiliated with the Burning Blade.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil Soulscar want Fizzle's Claw?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar wants proof that Fizzle is dead. The Burning Blade works in secret, and the claw confirms that this threat to Durotar has been removed.
Fizzle Darkstorm’s claw was taken at his camp in Thunder Ridge, northwest of Razor Hill in Durotar.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade doing in Durotar?
aliases: why are cultists in thunder ridge
faq.answer: The Burning Blade seeks to undermine the new orcish homeland through demonic corruption, dark sorcery, and civil unrest. Warlocks like Fizzle establish hidden camps to spread chaos across the region.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can present Fizzle’s claw in Razor Hill. It helps cleanse Durotar of shadow cults threatening the young nation’s safety.
As a warlock, you know Fizzle Darkstorm used fel arts in service of the Burning Blade. He turned his talents against the Horde.
